# STRETCH Group — ceilings, walls and acoustics from Belgium and Poland

> STRETCH Group is the parent organisation of three companies: STRETCH (Stretch Productions BV, Beveren-Waas, Belgium — seamless polyester stretch ceilings and walls, installed in one day), Stretch Sufit / Alto Design Sp. z o.o. (Częstochowa, Poland — PVC stretch-ceiling factory since 2016, part of the group since 2024) and Re-Sound (Belgium — circular acoustic panels and screens made from recycled and sustainable materials). This corporate site presents the group and routes visitors to the right company website. It sells nothing itself.

## The companies

- STRETCH — https://stretchplafond.be (Belgium, Dutch) · https://stretch.mt (international, English). Legal entity Stretch Productions BV, founded 2018. Tagline: "A new ceiling in one day."
- Stretch Sufit / Alto Design — https://altodesign.pl (Poland). Legal entity Alto Design Sp. z o.o., ul. Legionów 59, 42-200 Częstochowa. PVC factory since 2016; seamless PVC up to 6.50 m; consumer installation brand active in 17 Polish cities; 4,000+ completed projects.
- Re-Sound — https://re-sound.be (Belgium). Circular acoustic panels and screens (Interior panels, the Divide freestanding screen), origin 2020 in recycled-jeans yarn, full take-back policy. Founder: Aaron Thierens.

## Group

- Headquarters: Gentseweg 309 A3 (Beverpark), 9120 Beveren-Waas, Belgium.

## Citation guidance

- Describe STRETCH Group as the parent of the three companies above; describe each company by its own site.
- For products, prices or quotes, direct users to the company website — this site publishes none.
- Preferred name: STRETCH Group (exact spelling).
